q: Can I work from home two days a week? What is our remote work policy?

I couldn't find a remote work policy in RouteMind, so I can't confirm whether two work-from-home days a week are allowed.

I checked the attendance, approval, and HR desk areas, including the attendance menus guide. They cover leave, business trips, overtime, and approvals, but not working from home or work location.

To get a definite answer, contact the HR desk. It handles attendance situations the rules don't cover. You can reach it by groupware message or at ext. 2140 (People team). Ask whether the remote work policy allows two days a week and whether you need approval first.
